annotations.title: Is it a French approved e-invoicing platform (PA)?

description:
Is this e-invoicing platform on France's official list of Plateformes Agréées (PA)? name = platform or company name
(e.g. 'Pennylane'), website = its site (e.g. 'https://www.acubeapi.com/'); give at least one. Checks the DGFiP lists on
impots.gouv.fr: registered PAs (with registration date) and operators awaiting interoperability tests. Returns
on_official_list, status (approved | awaiting_interop_tests | possible_match | not_found), scored matches, list date and the
official source. Use for supplier due diligence before the French reform (receive from 1 Sep 2026, SMEs issue from
1 Sep 2027). A 'solution compatible' is not a PA itself. Unofficial copy; the official lists prevail.

limit.description: Maximum number of matches to return (1-20, default 5).
limit.title: Limit

name.description: Platform or company name to look up (give name, website or both).
